source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of sex-linked traits in humans (PDF 106-108).

blocks.text: X-linked recessive khasiyatein auraton mein mardon se kam hoti hain. Aurat mein aisi khasiyat sirf tab zahir hoti hai jab us ke dono X par recessive allele ho, jab ke mard mein X par sirf aik allele kaafi hai kyunke Y par is gene ka allele nahi. Is liye yeh khasiyat har us mard mein zahir hoti hai jis ke paas is ka allele ho. Misalein muscular dystrophy, red-green colour-blindness aur haemophilia hain.

items: Agar maa mein khasiyat ho to us ke sab beton mein hogi.
Agar maa carrier (heterozygous) ho to us ke 50% bete ise virasat mein le sakte hain.
Agar baap mein ho to us ki sab betiyan carrier hongi kyunke unhein us ka X milta hai, aur koi beta nahi kyunke beton ko us ka X nahi milta.

blocks.alt: Teen khandani charts, daire auraton aur chokor mardon ke liye; bhare hue mutasir aur nuqte wale daire carrier. Carrier maa XH Xh x normal baap XH Y: aik normal aur aik carrier beti, aik normal aur aik mutasir beta. Normal maa x mutasir baap Xh Y: dono betiyan carrier, dono bete normal. Mutasir maa Xh Xh x normal baap: betiyan carrier, sab bete mutasir.
blocks.caption: X-linked recessive khasiyaton ki virasat (Figure 18.15 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: X-linked recessive allele (h) mard mein hamesha zahir hota hai jab us ke paas ho, kyunke us ka akela X maa se aata hai aur Y par mutabiq allele nahi hota; aurat mein yeh sirf tab zahir hota hai jab us ke dono X par ho. Is liye carrier maa yeh aadhe beton ko deti hai jo mutasir hote hain, aur aadhi betiyon ko jo carrier banti hain; mutasir baap apna X har beti ko deta hai jo carrier banti hai, aur kisi bete ko nahi; mutasir maa ke sab bete mutasir hote hain. Kitab ki misalein haemophilia A aur B, red-green colour-blindness aur Duchenne muscular dystrophy hain.

blocks.text: Kitab ki misalein vitamin D-resistant rickets (vitamin D ko theek se istemal na kar pana, jis se haddiyan naram aur kamzor), Rett syndrome (nashonuma ki aasabi bimari jis mein bolna khatam, haathon ki barbaar harkat aur chalne mein mushkil) aur Aicardi syndrome (dimagh ki ghair maamooli nashonuma) hain.

items: Agar maa mein khasiyat ho (homozygous ya heterozygous) to us ke 50% bachche ise le sakte hain; homozygous maa sab ko deti hai.
Agar baap mein ho to us ki sab betiyan ise leti hain aur koi beta nahi.

blocks.title: Kya dono jinson mein barabar?
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke X-linked dominant khasiyatein maada aur nar mein barabar hoti hain. Kyunke aurat ke do X hain aur allele rakhne ke do mauqe, is liye yeh khasiyatein aam taur par auraton mein taqreeban do guna hoti hain.

blocks.alt: Teen khandani charts. X-linked dominant, mutasir maa XD Xd x normal baap: har jins ka aik mutasir aur aik normal bachcha. X-linked dominant, mutasir baap XD Y x normal maa: dono betiyan mutasir, dono bete normal. Y-linked, mutasir baap jis ke Y par allele t: har beta mutasir, har beti normal. Notes panel mein kitab ki misalein.
blocks.caption: X-linked dominant aur Y-linked virasat (Figures 18.16 aur 18.17 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: X-linked dominant allele (D) jab maujood ho to kisi bhi jins mein zahir hota hai. Heterozygous mutasir maa yeh apne aadhe bachchon ko deti hai, bete hon ya betiyan; mutasir baap apna X har beti ko deta hai, is liye sab betiyan mutasir aur koi beta nahi. Kitab ki misalein vitamin D-resistant rickets, Rett syndrome aur Aicardi syndrome hain. Y-linked (holandric) genes Y ke us hisse par hote hain jis ka X par koi mutabiq hissa nahi, is liye yeh sirf mardon mein zahir hote aur baap se har bete ko jate hain; kitab ki misalein kaan ke kinare ke baal (hypertrichosis), 'porcupine man' aur jure hue paon ki ungliyan hain.

blocks.text: Y chromosome par X ke muqable mein kaafi kam genes hain, is liye Y-linked khasiyatein kam hain. Y-linked genes ke alleles X par nahi; inhein holandric genes kehte hain aur yeh sirf Y ke non-homologous hisse par hote hain. Y-linked khasiyatein sirf mardon mein aati aur sirf baap se bete ko jati hain. Kitab ki misalein hypertrichosis (kaan ke kinare par baal), 'porcupine man' (jism par seedhe sakht baal) aur paon ki ungliyon ka jura hona hain; in misalon ki genetic bunyad par ikhtilaf hai.

blocks.title: Maloomat: SRY gene
blocks.text: Mardon ke Y chromosome par aik khaas gene SRY (sex-determining region Y) hai. Yeh aisa protein banata hai jo testes ki nashonuma shuru karta aur zanana tolidi dhaanchon ki nashonuma rokta hai.

blocks.prompt: Rang-andha mard aisi aurat se shadi karta hai jo carrier nahi. Beton aur betiyon ke imkanaat kya hain?
blocks.explanation: Beton ko maa ka normal X milta hai, is liye koi rang-andha nahi; har beti ko baap ka X milta hai, is liye sab betiyan normal nazar wali carriers.

items: X-linked recessive: mardon mein zyada; carrier maa aadhe beton ko deti.
X-linked dominant: mutasir baap sab betiyon ko deta, beton ko nahi.
Y-linked (holandric): sirf baap se har bete ko; SRY testis ki nashonuma shuru karta.
